scope: Photographs of the house held in the wayback image archive (Great House Farm Part 1–3 sets).
method: Each photograph was examined by eye. Each distinct piece of furniture gets one entry. Two sightings are merged only where the room, the setting and the piece itself agree; the reason is stated for every merged sighting. Period and style are judgements from the photographs and are marked not checked.

items.name: Glazed breakfront display cabinet, dining room
items.period: Late Victorian or Edwardian, c.1880–1910 (not checked)
items.basis: Glazed upper doors with astragal glazing bars, carved cresting with turned finials and a projecting centre section are typical of late nineteenth-century cabinet work; judged from the photographs only.
items.features: Three-bay glazed upper section over a closed base; carved cresting with finials along the top; projecting centre (breakfront); used to display china and glass.

sightings.note: Same carved cresting, finials and glazing pattern; black-and-white view of the same room.

items.name: Extending dining table, dining room
items.period: Victorian, mid to late nineteenth century (not checked)
items.basis: Rounded ends on turned, reeded legs, the usual form of a Victorian extending mahogany table; judged from the photographs only.
items.features: Long table with rounded ends on turned legs; usually laid with a lace runner, candelabra and cut-glass bowl.

sightings.note: Same table setting (lace runner, candelabra, cut-glass bowl) in front of the display cabinet.
Same room as p1-109 (the display cabinet behind it), same rounded end and turned legs.
Same pink-walled room and doorway as p1-060.

items.name: Set of slat-back dining chairs, dining room
items.period: Late nineteenth or early twentieth century (not checked)
items.basis: Vertical-slat backs and turned front legs; judged from the photographs only.
items.features: Upright chairs with vertical slats in the back and a curved top rail; several matching chairs round the dining table.

sightings.note: Same slat-back form round the same table setting.
Same slat pattern beside the same display cabinet.

items.name: Occasional lamp table with undershelf
items.room: Dining or sitting room beside the fireplace
items.period: Edwardian or early twentieth century (not checked)
items.basis: Small top on slender cabriole legs joined by an undershelf; judged from the photographs only.
items.features: Small top carrying a table lamp; slender shaped legs; a lower shelf between the legs.

sightings.note: Same position beside the fireplace with a panelled door behind; same leg and undershelf form; black-and-white view.

items.name: Tapestry-covered open armchair
items.basis: Open arms on a show-wood frame with a tapestry seat and back; judged from one photograph.
items.features: Show-wood frame, open arms, patterned tapestry upholstery on the seat and back.

items.name: Armchair with floral loose cover, dining room
items.basis: Fully upholstered form with a patterned loose cover; judged from one photograph.
items.features: Deep upholstered armchair in a large-patterned floral cover.

items.name: Bed with slatted ends and roundel panel
items.period: Early to mid twentieth century (not checked)
items.basis: Plain slatted head- and footboard with a turned roundel in the centre panel; judged from the photographs only.
items.features: Wooden headboard and footboard of upright slats; a carved or turned roundel in the centre of the footboard; low posts.

sightings.note: Same slatted ends with the same roundel in the footboard.
Same slatted footboard rail; the roundel is out of frame.

items.name: Dressing chest with swing mirror, bedroom (left)
items.basis: Chest of drawers with a swing mirror on uprights; judged from one photograph.
items.features: Drawers below; swing mirror between turned uprights above.

items.name: Dressing table with swing mirror, bedroom (right)
items.basis: Dressing table with a framed swing mirror; judged from one photograph.
items.features: Framed swing mirror over a small dressing table by the window.

items.name: Slatted bedside cabinet
items.period: Early to mid twentieth century (not checked)
items.basis: Its slatted front matches the slatted bed ends in the same room, which suggests a bedroom suite; judgement only.
items.features: Small cabinet with an upright-slat front, beside the bed.

items.name: Dark-wood wardrobe, bedroom
items.period: Late nineteenth or early twentieth century (not checked)
items.basis: Tall panelled wardrobe with a cornice; judged from one photograph.
items.features: Tall wardrobe with panelled doors and a moulded cornice.

items.name: Longcase clock, hall
items.period: Eighteenth or early nineteenth century (not checked)
items.basis: Arched brass dial and a hood with columns are typical of eighteenth-century longcase clocks; the photographs do not show the maker or the movement.
items.features: Tall case; hood with columns; arched dial; stands in the hall beside a round mirror.

sightings.note: Same hall, beside the same round mirror and chest.
Same hall seen from the other side, beside the same round mirror.

items.name: Panelled oak chest with brass candlesticks, hall
items.period: Seventeenth or eighteenth century style (not checked)
items.basis: Fielded panels on the front of a low oak chest are typical of the joined-oak tradition; the photographs alone cannot show whether it is period or later; judgement only.
items.features: Low chest with a panelled front; the top used to display a row of brass candlesticks.

sightings.note: Same row of brass candlesticks under the same round mirror.

items.name: Round wall mirror, hall
items.basis: Round framed glass hung above the chest; judged from the photographs only.
items.features: Round mirror in a moulded frame, hung above the oak chest.

sightings.note: Same mirror above the same chest.
Same mirror above the same chest.

items.name: Carved mirror-back sideboard, beamed room
items.basis: Carved back with a mirror over a cupboard base is a common Victorian sideboard form; judged from the photographs only.
items.features: Cupboard base; tall carved back with mirror plates and shelves; stands under the beam with ceiling hooks.

items.name: Long farmhouse table, beamed room
items.basis: Long plain-topped table typical of farmhouse kitchens; judged from one photograph.
items.features: Long rectangular plain top running across the room.

items.name: High-backed dining chairs, flagstoned room
items.period: Late nineteenth or twentieth century (not checked)
items.basis: Tall upholstered backs; judged from one photograph.
items.features: Tall-backed chairs set round a table on a flagstone floor.

items.name: Windsor armchair, brick inglenook
items.basis: Spindle back, turned legs and stretchers are the Windsor chair form; judged from one photograph.
items.features: Spindle back with a curved arm bow, solid seat, turned legs with stretchers.

items.name: Spindle-back armchair with striped cushion, kitchen hearth
items.period: Late nineteenth or early twentieth century (not checked)
items.basis: Spindle back with shaped arms and a loose striped cushion; whether it stands on rockers is not visible; judged from one photograph.
items.features: Spindle back, shaped arms, loose striped back cushion; beside the stone hearth.

items.name: Wheel-back style kitchen chairs (partial view)
items.basis: Only the top rails and a pierced back are in view; judged from one photograph.
items.features: Matching chairs round the kitchen table; one shows a pierced, wheel-like back.

items.name: Glazed china cabinet with arched glazing
items.basis: Glazed door with arched glazing bars on a slender cabinet is typical of Edwardian display cabinets; judged from one photograph.
items.features: Glazed door with arched glazing bars; shelves of china behind the glass.

items.name: Ladder-back rocking chair, sitting room
items.period: Nineteenth or early twentieth century (not checked)
items.basis: Horizontal ladder slats on a rocking frame; judged from one photograph.
items.features: Ladder back of horizontal slats on curved rockers.

items.name: Buttoned leather armchair, sitting room
items.basis: Deep-buttoned back on a low upholstered chair; judged from one photograph.
items.features: Low armchair with a deep-buttoned back in dark leather or leather-cloth.

items.name: Glazed bookcase, blue sitting room
items.basis: Glazed doors over a closed base; judged from one photograph.
items.features: Glazed upper doors with books and ornaments behind; closed base.

items.name: Low coffee table, blue sitting room
items.period: Mid to late twentieth century (not checked)
items.basis: Low rectangular table; whether the top is glass or polished wood is not clear; judged from one photograph.
items.features: Low rectangular table in front of the fireplace.

items.name: Two-tier side table with turned supports
items.basis: Two tiers on turned columns; judged from one photograph.
items.features: Two tiers joined by turned supports, carrying ornaments.

items.name: Pine bunk beds
items.basis: Plain pine bunk frame with a ladder; judged from one photograph.
items.features: Two-tier pine bunk beds.

items.name: Single bed with curved wooden ends
items.basis: Curved solid head- and footboard; judged from one photograph.
items.features: Single bed with curved solid-wood head- and footboard.

items.name: Oak chest with candlesticks, flagstoned passage
items.basis: Low chest against the passage wall carrying a pair of candlesticks; whether it is the hall chest (FUR-0013) photographed elsewhere is not established, so it is kept as a separate entry.
items.features: Low chest against the passage wall; pair of candlesticks on top.

items.name: Side table with turned legs, bedroom
items.basis: Small table on turned legs; judged from one photograph.
items.features: Small side table on turned legs beside an armchair.
